Name: Unsettling Item Descriptions REVIVED
Author: phoenixofthestars07
Description:
[color=#D4D4D8]hello yes come into my house of horrors and look at this labour of love. please it took so long my shoulders hurt[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]From the original mod page, "Does your game feel as bland as fiddlehead risotto? As common as carp? Install this slightly-spoopy mod to add mildly disturbing or uncomfortable descriptive text to over 800 in-game items!"[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Now with (most of) everything from 1.5 and 6! Clothes, hats, and boots; achievements; the tool descriptions; and every goddamn item. I did my best to make everything either unsettling or, when I couldn't think of anything, funny. I also tried to keep with the established jokes from the original, like all the unsmelted ores being choking hazards. There are a few shirts I couldn't think of anything for, so if you have ideas or if I managed to miss something, please come tell me! Similarly, if you don't think a description is unsettling enough, also come tell me as I know a few are cliche and several are a little lackluster. I promise I won't be annoyed so long as you have a genuinely better suggestion, but when you make it please keep in mind that I am one person who is also struggling to get a job and learning how to adult whereas the original mod had a team of 20 people.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]My favourites (of the ones I wrote meself :3):[/color]
[quote][color=#D4D4D8]Night sky shirt: "The fabric is cold and abyssal. The vastness of the universe blooms behind your eyes whenever you close them. You don't really want to sleep anymore."[/color][/quote][quote][color=#D4D4D8]Tiara: "The inner band is decorated with tiny shards of glass. An absolute pain to wear."[/color][/quote][quote][color=#D4D4D8]Piña colada: "IF YOU LIKE PIÑA COLADAS~ AND GETTING CAUGHT IN THE RAIN~"[/color][/quote][quote][color=#D4D4D8]Monster musk: "Use these monster pheromones to make yourself smell delicious and draw more out of hiding. Open to interpretation."[/color][/quote][quote][color=#D4D4D8]Mr. Qi's hat: "Your skin is tinged blue when you wear it and you feel a strange urge to cause mischief."[/color][/quote][color=#D4D4D8]...aaand I'll leave you to discover the rest!! :)[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Also from the original mod, the Q&A:[/color]

[center][color=#D4D4D8][b]Q&A[/b][/color][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Q: Geez, those are some WEIRD nature facts. How much of this stuff is true?[/b]
[b]A. Most of it is true![/b] Don't treat us like a textbook—we can't [i]guarantee[/i] the truth of every description. But we [b]did[/b] do a lot of research for this mod, and tried to avoid spreading false information as facts. Remember that some of the animals, plants, and minerals in Stardew Valley are fictional or only loosely based on the real world. We may have gotten more creative for those. :)

By and large, though, the weirdest and most bizarre nature facts revealed in this mod are all [b]true[/b]. We figure that weird-but-true facts are a lot more unsettling than fiction, anyway. Isn't it more uncomfortable when it's real?

[b]Q: Does this mod make it harder to play the game?[/b]
[b]A. Brand-new players [i]may[/i] be disadvantaged by using this mod.[/b] Sometimes, a helpful description relating to an item's purpose has been replaced with unsettling but less-informative text. If you're not already familiar with the purpose and use of most in-game items, you might have a harder time. We recommend that players use the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/]wiki[/url] to look up unfamiliar items!

The amount of information left out is [b]small[/b], and should not be a problem for experienced players. All descriptions for seed items, for example, still contain season, growth, and harvest information. (I have done my best to continue this!!)

[b]Q: Hey! I found a description that isn't very unsettling.[/b]
[b]A. Feel free to suggest a better one![/b] Our [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15_MDeQ54nJamVVA4qy_opx-u9Mgs7aPaA34aO6Pt0rU/edit?gid=400988458#gid=400988458]spreadsheets[/url] are open for anyone to comment with suggestions or improvements. Generally speaking, the creepiness of individual descriptions in this mod may vary. Some are weird, and a few are just silly.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8](note from me: comment section here is better for suggestions for the new-ish items as I have not updated the spreadsheets)

We are actively collecting suggestions for "silly" descriptions also, and will consider expanding this mod in the future to include an option making all descriptions silly, all unsettling, or fifty-fifty randomized. This depends on how many new descriptions we can collect, so please contribute your ideas! STILL HAPPENING!![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Compatibility: none right now, save for a single line regarding Pierre for Piper - A Pierre Rewrite, BUT! feel free to ask!! I am completely open to adding compat, I just didn't want to waste my time and energy adding it for a mod that people didn't actually want compat for.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29834]Piper - A Pierre Rewrite[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26775]Healthy Blobfish 1.6[/url][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]PLANS: Night Market Expansion, Advanced Cooking, Nature in the Valley, and SH's Wild Animals In The Valley. idk if others want these but they're the ones I want lol. also some of East Scarp's add-ons[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Config:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]DescribeObjects:[/b]
Use unsettling descriptions for normal objects. Defaults to true.
[b]DescribeBigCraftables:[/b]
Use unsettling descriptions for big craftables (large objects). Defaults to true.
[b]DescribeWeapons:[/b]
Use unsettling descriptions for weapons. Defaults to true.
[b]DescribeTools:[/b]
Use unsettling descriptions for tools. Defaults to true.
[b]DescribeBoots:[/b]
Use unsettling descriptions for shoes and boots. Defaults to true.
[b]DescribeHats:[/b]
Use unsettling descriptions for hats and headwear. Defaults to true.
[b]DescribeClothing:[/b]
Use unsettling descriptions for pants and shirts. Defaults to true.
[b]DescribeBuildings:[/b]
Use unsettling descriptions for farm buildings. Defaults to true.[/color]

Installation:
1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher.[/url]
3. Download this mod from the link in the header above.
4. Unzip the mod and place the [CP] Unsettling Item Descriptions folder inside your Mods folder.
5. Run the game using SMAPI and enjoy :)

[color=#D4D4D8]Credits: ofc everyone from the original Unsettling Descriptions team, linked just below, but [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6822]here[/url] is the original mod as well for your perusal. Everything on the spreadsheets that didn't have a suggestion and/or was listed as not unsettling enough was written by me, plus several I didn't like the suggestions for, and I added onto or edited a few from the original as well. additionally, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SilvertongueRED]SilvertongueRED[/url] converted the og UID to Content Patcher and uploaded it to Google Drive [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rSggZP2CpB1OC5ZjGVmyN761S2I9NGrO/view?usp=sharing]here[/url]. they are a big part of how this was even possible!!![/color]
